headline: UK government survey reports business AI adoption doubled in 2026
summary: A UK government-commissioned business survey reports that AI use among businesses rose from 16% in 2025 to 32% in 2026. Its 2026 fieldwork interviewed 3,503 private-sector businesses with at least five employees; 50 follow-up interviews and seven adopter site visits added context. Half of AI adopters reported an overall productivity increase, generally modest, while cost effects were mixed. These are survey-reported findings, not causal estimates; the technical annex reports a 5% response rate among businesses called.
